jurisdictional_context: LOPIVI Ley Organica 8/2021 de 4 de junio Disposicion adicional decimoseptima explicitly inadmits SAP (sindrome de alienacion parental) in family-court proceedings affecting children. Second statutory PA-critique jurisdiction worldwide after Brazil's Lei 12.318/2010 (which by contrast recognises alienacao parental) - and the opposite-direction mirror. Cleanest statutory PA-disclaimer in Europe. Reinforced by Ministerio de Igualdad 2020 informe (Delegacion del Gobierno contra la Violencia de Genero), Tribunal Supremo STS 519/2017, and post-LOPIVI Audiencia Provincial case-law (notably AP Madrid Sec. 22a and AP Barcelona Sec. 12a). CGPJ Guia Practica de la LO 1/2004 instructs judges to treat SAP invocations as potential post-separation DV tactics. COP (Consejo General de la Psicologia) positions are fragmented by Comunidad Autonoma: COP Madrid recognition-tolerant, COPC Cataluna middle, COP-Asturias forensic-empirical, COP Andalucia critique-leaning. Forensic structure has three streams: career-civil-servant Equipos Psicosociales adscritos a los Juzgados de Familia (EPF); Instituto de Medicina Legal y Ciencias Forenses (IMLCF) per Comunidad Autonoma; private peritos de parte.
lopivi_disposicion_adicional_17_verbatim: Disposicion adicional decimoseptima. Practicas no avaladas por la comunidad cientifica. Las Administraciones Publicas, jueces y Tribunales, velaran por evitar que pueda ser tomado en consideracion, en los procesos relativos a ninos, ninas y adolescentes, planteamientos teoricos o criterios sin aval cientifico que presupongan interferencia o manipulacion adulta, como el llamado sindrome de alienacion parental.

structural_findings: LOPIVI Disposicion adicional decimoseptima is the strongest statutory PA-disclaimer in Europe and the opposite-direction mirror of Brazil's Lei 12.318/2010. Spain is the cleanest critique-camp jurisdiction worldwide.

Post-LOPIVI terminological shift: Spanish recognition camp has not retreated, it has renamed - 'SAP' -> 'interferencias parentales' / 'manipulacion de la voluntad del menor' (language LOPIVI does not explicitly inadmit). Tejedor's PIVIP is the canonical example. This is the central jurisdictional puzzle for any practitioner working in post-LOPIVI Spain.

Institutional split is by Comunidad Autonoma, not national. COP umbrella has no enforced national position; positions are produced at Colegio level (COP Madrid recognition-tolerant, COPC middle, COP-Asturias forensic-empirical, COP Andalucia critique). This differs from Germany (BDP/DGPs + Psychotherapeutenkammern nationally coherent) and UK (BPS/HCPC nationally coherent).

Critique camp's institutional victory is asymmetric: statutory disclaimer achieved but clinical-services capture not achieved. EPF and IMLCF teams remain methodologically eclectic; peritos de parte in recognition tradition continue to operate. Post-2021 pattern is case-by-case re-litigation, not practice replacement.

Forensic three-stream structure (EPF + IMLCF + peritos de parte) is unique in Europe. Recognition camp operational base = stream 3 (peritos de parte). Critique camp institutional anchor = stream 2 (IMLCF / Igualdad). EPFs are methodologically uncertain middle.
